phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, both sides have limited information. Opponent posture is unknown, own posture is also uncertain. Focus on establishing a solid foundation.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when more information about opponent's posture becomes available, or when a significant event occurs (e.g., opponent attack, expansion).
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop safely with steady production, economy, and technology; if ground cues appear, pivot to ground army strength and economy growth.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path with safety checks. Keep production, economy, technology, and expansion directions steady. If opponent shows a ground posture with Zergling, strengthen ground army, increase economy, and continue production and technology.
phase_policies.title: Safe Development with Ground Contingency
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to heavy technology or expansion without maintaining sufficient army production to defend against early Zergling pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early midgame, still limited information. Both sides maintain unknown postures. Continue safe development.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when more information about opponent's posture becomes available, or when a significant event occurs (e.g., opponent attack, expansion).
phase_policies.routing_summary: Continue safe development; if ground cues appear, strengthen ground forces and economy while maintaining production.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path with safety checks. Keep production, economy, technology, and expansion directions steady. If opponent shows a ground posture with Zergling and Queen, strengthen ground army, increase economy, and continue production and technology.
phase_policies.title: Steady Development with Ground Adaptation
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect army production while expanding or teching; ensure a solid ground core to handle potential Zergling aggression.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, still limited information. Both sides maintain unknown postures. Continue safe development.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if a major engagement occurs.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain steady development; if heavy ground confrontation emerges, bolster ground army and economy while continuing tech.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path with safety checks. Keep production, economy, technology, and expansion directions steady. If opponent shows a heavy ground posture with Zergling, Hydralisk, Roach, Queen, strengthen ground army, increase economy, and continue production and technology.
phase_policies.title: Safe Development with Ground Confrontation Readiness
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend with ground forces without proper support; avoid neglecting upgrades or production while focusing on economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late midgame, still limited information. Both sides maintain unknown postures. Continue safe development.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if a major engagement occurs.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Continue safe development; if heavy ground confrontation, strengthen ground defense, economy, and expansion while maintaining production.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path with safety checks. Keep production, economy, technology, and expansion directions steady. If opponent shows a heavy ground posture with Zergling, Roach, Queen, strengthen ground army, increase defense, economy, and expansion, and continue production and technology.
phase_policies.title: Safe Development with Ground Defense Emphasis
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to expansion or economy without reinforcing defense; avoid neglecting army production and upgrades in a ground confrontation.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
